sloka: महाकायो ऽतिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ ।एतैः सर्वैः परिवृतो महावीर्यो महाबलः ।। ७.२७.३१ ॥
transliteration: mahākāyo 'tikāyaśca devāntakanarāntakau ।etaiḥ sarvaiḥ parivṛto mahāvīryo mahābalaḥ ।। 7.27.31 ॥

translations.english: Surrounded by all these, namely Mahakaya, Atikaya, Devantaka, and Narantaka, was one of immense valor and strength.
